config.visionText: Empower patients with the freedom to access quality healthcare services through digital integration anytime, anywhere.
config.missionText: Deliver quality personalised care by merging of best medical practises with modern technology.
config.lastMinuteSpeechText: Good afternoon, everyone. Thank you for being here today.As we look back at where we started this year, I want to begin with a simple thank you. We faced real shifts and unexpected hurdles. Because of your hard work, your creativity, and your care for one another, we did not just get through it—we adapted and grew. Every milestone we reached belongs to this team.
